Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Blinkit's e-gift card intro - a 3D gift box pops open, a gift card bursts out with brand chips and gold confetti, and everything settles floating around the card above the explainer steps.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Blinkit's cream "E-Gift Cards" explainer: back chevron top-left, action icons top-right, the serif headline "E-Gift Cards" with the sub-line "Send quick & thoughtful gifts in 3 easy steps", and three numbered steps with gold icons along the bottom. Center stage, a white 3D gift box with a gold ribbon. It pops open and a dark green "₹1000" gift card launches out tilted, ringed by floating brand chips (small circular logos) and gold ribbon confetti.

## Motion spec
Pattern: gift box pop with confetti, ~2.5s total.
- The box idles with a subtle scale breathe (1 to 1.02, 2s).
- The lid pops: the box squashes (scale 0.95, 100ms) then the lid springs off and the gift card launches upward out of the box (spring stiffness 300 damping 18), rotating to a slight tilt as it clears the rim.
- Brand chips and gold ribbon curls burst out with the card (~10 pieces, outward velocities, 600ms), then float into a loose ring around it.
- The card and chips settle into a gentle hover (plus/minus 5px bob, staggered 2 to 3s periods) while a few confetti pieces drift down and fade.

## Calibration
- The card is the hero: largest element after the pop, crisply legible "₹1000".
- The explainer text and steps never move - all energy is above the headline.

## Reduced motion
Card fades in above the open box.

## Don't miss
- The card comes out of the box - it starts inside the lid line, never appears beside it.
- Gold confetti and ribbon curls match the box's ribbon.
